manifest.description: This skill provides comprehensive instructions for interacting with the Raindrop.io bookmarks service via its REST API using curl and jq. It covers authentication, CRUD operations for collections, raindrops (bookmarks), tags, highlights, filters, import/export, and backups. Use this skill whenever the user asks to work with their bookmarks from Raindrop.io, including reading, creating, updating, deleting, searching, or organising bookmarks and collections.
